tools.name: erp.warehouse.analyze
tools.description: Run read-only 5-agent Warehouse ERP analysis for a warehouse_id.

tools.name: erp.warehouse.snapshot
tools.description: Fetch raw read-only ERP snapshot (connectors, inbounds, skus, locations) for a warehouse_id.

tools.name: erp.inventory.plan
tools.description: Reorder points, safety stock, order quantities, ABC/XYZ classes and dead/slow stock for a shipper's SKUs, from supplied demand history and lead times. Formulas are stated in the result. Refuses to mix shippers' data unless told which one.

file_path.description: CSV or JSON file of SKU records

skus.description: SKU records: sku, on_hand, lead_time_days, daily_demand

owner_id.description: Shipper (货主) to analyse. Required when records span several shippers.

all_owners.description: Internal 3PL view across all shippers. Output is marked not for client distribution.

tools.name: erp.carriers.score
tools.description: Carrier scorecard by lane (on-time rate with a confidence lower bound, median cost/kg, exception rate), freight cost anomalies and like-for-like savings, from supplied waybills. Refuses to mix shippers' data unless told which one.

file_path.description: CSV or JSON file of waybills

waybills.description: Waybills: carrier, total_cost, origin, destination, billed_weight_kg, is_on_time

min_shipments.description: Minimum shipments for a carrier-lane to be ranked, default 20

owner_id.description: Shipper (货主) to analyse. Required when records span several shippers.

all_owners.description: Internal 3PL view across all shippers. Output is marked not for client distribution.

tools.name: erp.freight.audit
tools.description: Audit freight spend, on-time rate, and weight billing anomalies from waybills or CSV/JSON.

tools.name: erp.warehouse.task
tools.description: Delegate a bounded warehouse navigation simulation to the warehouse task agent. Use action=create with the user's goal, a known or explicitly requested demo scenario, constraints and a unique request_id. Then start once with task_id/request_id and use wait (timeout_ms <= 1000) or status until terminal. The native agent observes, plans, moves, replans after obstacles, and verifies the goal itself. Actions: health, create, start, status, wait, stop, obstacle, trace. Never report completion from a start acknowledgement: require completed and verified=true. Simulation only; no hardware, real warehouse sensing, or paid inference in the executor.

goal.description: User's task goal and constraints, as context; never a shell command.

request_id.description: Required only for create/start/obstacle. Stable unique operation ID; reuse only for an identical operation. Omit for health/status/wait/stop/trace.

timeout_ms.description: Required only for wait. Maximum 1000ms per call; query again if still running.

inputSchema.description: Goal-directed logical warehouse simulation. Use only fields applicable to the selected action. create: action, request_id, goal, scenario, optional constraints. start: action, task_id, request_id. status/stop/trace: action, task_id ONLY. wait: action, task_id, timeout_ms ONLY. obstacle: action, task_id, request_id, cell. health: action ONLY. Never send request_id to read actions.

tools.name: erp.shipper.digest
tools.description: Build a tenant-isolated daily shipper digest (reorder alerts, stockout risks, freight billing anomalies, and carrier lane switch recommendations) strictly scoped to a single owner_id.
